input_units.graph6: graph6 encoding of an undirected labeled graph

timing_contract: Full graph adjacency is permitted; certificate facet coefficients and published ranks are forbidden predictors.
calibration: None for deterministic bounds; source-independent exhaustive bitset search supplies labels. Labels are computable mathematical invariants, not physical measurements.
independent_unit: Source certificate implication family; author-certified graphs and linked edge subgraphs remain together

constant.equation: y_hat = training-fold median(target); final coefficient refit on development only

edge_lp.equation: alpha_upper=floor(max sum_i x_i subject to 0<=x_i<=1 and x_i+x_j<=1 for each edge)

exact.equation: Enumerate vertex subsets in descending size and return the largest independent subset

attempt_003.equation: alpha_upper=number of cliques in the declared greedy vertex partition

attempt_004.equation: Edge LP plus sum_(i in triangle) x_i<=1

attempt_005.equation: Triangle LP plus sum_(i in induced 5-cycle) x_i<=2

attempt_006.equation: alpha_hat=(greedy stable-set lower bound + strengthened LP upper bound)/2; this midpoint is not a certificate

reference.equation: y_hat = training-fold median(target); final coefficient refit on development only

uncertainty_policy.reason: Report per-group errors and worst-group error; no independent-row confidence intervals; one-event and finite catalogs are conditional diagnostics.

scope_limits: Finite selected source graphs, not theorem proving for arbitrary graphs or rediscovery of source LS+ ranks. Exact search comparator defines attainable error, so approximate bounds cannot claim superior accuracy.

exposure.historical_record: Source-aware public data. Limited schema/header and first-row previews recorded before task freeze; any inspected examples remain explicitly exposed. Confirmation performance withheld until selection and stopping freeze.
